subject: Re: [Project Basalt] Status: decision on memory ceiling + LRB timing
body:
Team,

Closing out two things.

Decision on the memory ceiling: we ship with the pruning approach, not the order cap. The 11% keystroke saving is the headline of this product and Yara's curves show order-4 gives back nearly half of it. The study slipped to Jun 19 as a result — acceptable, and the results held (10.6% KSPC reduction with pruning enabled, trie stable under 60MB across the 2h sessions).

Second: privacy review cleared last Tuesday with one condition — the consented-panel typing logs get deleted 90 days post-study. Alina, can someone own the deletion job so it's not a manual step?

LRB packet goes to Nadia this week targeting the late-July board slot. Demo is the live in-browser adaptation on the accessibility surface; no server anywhere in the loop is the closing slide.

Nice work all — this one's been smooth.

Priya
